summary: This bill prevents a scheduled reduction in the tax deduction for foreign-derived intangible income, maintaining the current deduction rate.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Internal Revenue Code to prevent a scheduled reduction in the deduction for foreign-derived intangible income, effectively maintaining a lower tax burden for certain businesses than would otherwise occur. This is the sole purpose of the bill.

The bill repeals the scheduled reduction in the FDII deduction under IRC section 250, permanently maintaining the 37.5% deduction rate. This prevents an increase in corporate tax revenue that would otherwise occur, directly reducing federal receipts relative to current law and thereby increasing the deficit to preserve the tax benefit for affected companies.
